beats.title: a quiet night turns into morning

beats.text: Eugh... *opening his eyes*
Huh? *feels someone's hand*
A-Amy...
( I must've got her so worried... )
Oh! *walking into the room* You're finally awake!
What time is it?
It's only 10AM dear, it's not late
Is Amy alright?
Yes, she stayed the whole night by your side.. Tails went home around 2AM
Ames *looks at her.*
( You did that for me? )
but she's hardly had any sleep.. So far she only had 2 hours. But she keeps waking up to check on you
( She's so beautiful when she's asleep like this )
by the way... there's someone who'd like to see you
Scourge?
Uhm.. I came to apologise.. about all the bad things I did to you
I also wanna apologise to Amy for trying to murder her ...
but most of all, thank you for saving my life. You almost got yourself killed risking that for someone you hate
I did that because you are my friend
I am?
You've always been my best friend, since kindergarden
I'm sorry too.. you can have my sister if you still love her *hugs him*
*chuckles* It depends *hugging him back*
*opening her eyes*
*giggles* Well this is nice, my boyfriend is cheating on me with Scourge!
AMY?! *turns around*
Uh oh someone's in trouble
Amy... *grabs her and hugs her*
It's good to see you're okay
*chuckles* Thanks, Ames
Sorry for trying to murder you, will you forgive me?
Of course I forgive you, Scourge-
So... do you think I'm well enough to perform at the musical tonight?
Don't be ridiculous, who else would I sing a love song with?
Psh, but I have something planned for a friend
